item.text:
I can’t give you a trustworthy maximum-score schedule without solving the full constrained optimization. The table includes 36 offices, and the answer depends on jointly choosing meeting slots, team assignments, travel gaps, and daily lunch breaks—not just fitting meetings into availability windows. I don’t want to present an unverified schedule as optimal.

If you can provide a solver or let me return a best-effort schedule rather than a proven maximum, I can proceed.
